item.text:
This round I checked whether a deeper static analyzer is available to extend the source-level audit.

`staticcheck`, `golangci-lint`, and `gosec` are not installed in the offline toolchain; `go vet` is the available static analysis. Its EPaxos output is limited to unkeyed struct literals whose field orders I checked, and it found no new EPaxos logic warning. The existing `curp`/`swift` warnings are outside this variant. I recorded this in the report’s coverage section.

Current status: 23 findings; five cluster controls pass; 34 epaxos finding tests fail as intended; the separate client, dlog, and config tests fail; the bounded randomized fault campaign remains 11 pass / 9 NOOP losses / 0 mixed divergences; the three-line diagnostic copy gives 14 passes / 22 unrelated failures; `go build ./...` passes; captured implementation files remain byte-identical to `../source`.
